title: Adaptive Regularization for Random Features: A Neighboring Early-Stopping Rule with Oracle-Rate Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2608.25513v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Random feature methods provide a scalable approximation to kernel ridge regression (KRR), but the regularization parameter that yields the oracle learning rate depends on unknown smoothness and capacity parameters. In this work, we propose a neighboring early-stopping rule for adaptive regularization in KRR with random features (KRR-RF). The method uses a grid that is uniform in inverse regularization and compares only adjacent estimators, reducing the number of discrepancy comparisons relative to standard all-pairs Lepskii-type procedures. Both the neighboring discrepancy and its empirical complexity term can be computed directly in the random feature space, without constructing the exact kernel Gram matrix. translated_title: 随机特征的自适应正则化：一种具有预言机速率的邻近早停规则
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.25513v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：随机特征方法提供了核岭回归（KRR）的可扩展近似，但产生预言机学习速率的正则化参数依赖于未知的光滑性和容量参数。在本工作中，我们提出了一种用于带随机特征的KRR（KRR-RF）自适应正则化的邻近早停规则。该方法使用在逆正则化上均匀的网格，并仅比较相邻估计器，相对于标准的全对Lepskii型程序，减少了差异比较的次数。相邻差异及其经验复杂度项都可以直接在随机特征空间中计算，无需构造精确的核Gram矩阵。我们建立了邻近KRR-RF估计器的高概率比较界，并表明在标准源和容量条件以及合适的网格和随机特征预算条件下，所选估计器能达到预言机速率。
tldr: 提出了一种基于邻近早停规则的自适应正则化方法，用于随机特征核岭回归，通过仅比较相邻估计器来降低计算复杂度，并在标准条件下实现预言机速率。
en_tdlr: A neighboring early-stopping rule is proposed for adaptive regularization in random-feature kernel ridge regression, which reduces comparison overhead by only comparing adjacent estimators and achieves oracle rates under standard conditions.
